item.title: Blockage resulting in flooding of carriageway, 20th October
item.description:
The drain along St Paul's Road opposite the junction to Dolly Lane. I have reported this drainage issue 4 times now and each time I'm told it has been addressed...it clearly hasn't 🙄 Several months ago a fatality occurred at this very location possibly due to this same issue. Until it is rectified there could be further accidents whereby cyclists like myself have to take evasive action to avoid the surface water.
